requirements.purpose: Replay a bounded metadata search response without network access.
Replay an exact identifier metadata document.
Replay file-list metadata without fetching file bytes.
Prove missing identifiers fail closed and do not invent records.
Prove malformed or partial metadata is rejected or marked incomplete.
Prove Retry-After is honored and retry budget is bounded.
Prove large file lists are capped and summarized safely.
Prove fixture replay and future live metadata code paths do not fetch item files.
